description: Source file defining ShareViewController, a UIViewController subclass that manages sharing content from iOS, including extracting shared data and attachments, preparing and sending messages to an OpenClaw gateway, and handling UI interactions.

classes.name: ShareViewController
classes.description: A view controller for managing the sharing extension UI and logic, including extracting shared content, preparing drafts, and sending messages to the OpenClaw gateway.

methods.name: viewDidLoad
methods.description: Initial setup after view loads, configuring UI and size.

methods.name: viewDidAppear
methods.description: Prepares the draft when view appears for the first time.

methods.name: setupUI
methods.description: Sets up UI components and layout constraints.

methods.name: prepareDraft
methods.description: Extracts shared content, prepares draft message, and updates UI.

methods.name: handleSendTap
methods.description: Handles tap on Send button, triggers message sending.

methods.name: handleCancelTap
methods.description: Handles tap on Cancel button, completes extension.

methods.name: sendCurrentDraft
methods.description: Validates and sends the current draft message.

methods.name: sendMessageToGateway
methods.description: Establishes connection to gateway and sends message with attachments.

methods.name: shouldRetryWithLegacyClientId
methods.description: Checks if the error should trigger a retry with a legacy client ID.

methods.name: showStatus
methods.description: Displays status message overlay in UI.

methods.name: composeDraft
methods.description: Builds a string message from shared content payload.

methods.name: sanitizeDraftFragment
methods.description: Cleans up raw text fragments before including in draft.

methods.name: extractSharedContent
methods.description: Asynchronously extracts shared URL, text, title, and attachments from extension context.

methods.name: loadImageAttachment
methods.description: Loads image data from provider, compresses, and encodes to base64.

methods.name: preferredImageTypeIdentifier
methods.description: Determines preferred image type identifier for provider.

methods.name: normalizedJPEGData
methods.description: Creates JPEG data with controlled size, reducing quality if necessary.

methods.name: loadURL
methods.description: Loads URL from provider asynchronously.

methods.name: loadText
methods.description: Loads textual data from provider asynchronously.

methods.name: loadURLValue
methods.description: Helper to load URL value asynchronously from provider.

methods.name: loadTextValue
methods.description: Helper to load text value asynchronously from provider.

methods.name: loadDataValue
methods.description: Helper to load data representation from provider.
